levels.surface: أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمذاني

notes: rule 11, narrated encounter: Musa b. Ja'far speaks and acts («أقام لنا ... فَقالَ») in a scene Hussein b. Bashir witnessed; read as the last link, but whether he is a source or only in the scene needs a ruling
«أبيه» names Ali's father by relation only; «ابنه علياً» and the Prophet «كَما أَقامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ» are in the scene, not links
